assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-s16.mp3.text: The Mid-Autumn Festival is celebrated by Chinese people across the world.
assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-s16.mp3.zh: 世界各地的华人都庆祝中秋节。

assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-s16.mp3.text: It is traditionally a harvest festival
assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-s16.mp3.zh: 传统上，这是一个庆祝丰收的节日，

assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-s16.mp3.text: to celebrate the rice and wheat that has been grown that year and it takes place on the full moon.
assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-s16.mp3.zh: 纪念当年稻米和小麦的收成，并在满月时举行。

assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-s17.mp3.text: Mooncakes are rarely made at home because the recipe is quite complicated.
assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-s17.mp3.zh: 月饼的做法相当复杂，人们很少在家制作。

assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-s17.mp3.text: Most people prefer to buy their mooncakes from a shop or a hotel.
assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-s17.mp3.zh: 多数人更愿意在商店或酒店购买月饼。

assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-s18.mp3.text: Now, the chef is taking a yellow ball of filling and wrapping it in a thin layer of pastry.
assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-s18.mp3.zh: 现在，厨师取一团黄色的馅料，用薄薄的一层饼皮包住它。

assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-s19.mp3.text: the chef takes a special wooden mold and shapes each mooncake one at a time.
assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-s19.mp3.zh: 厨师用一个特制的木模，逐个给月饼定形。

assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-s19.mp3.text: Each mooncake has a decoration on top of it.
assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-s19.mp3.zh: 每个月饼的表面都有装饰图案。

assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-s20.mp3.text: the mooncakes must be left for a day or two.
The butter from the filling will go into the pastry layer and make it soft and delicious.
assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-s20.mp3.zh: 馅里的黄油会渗进饼皮，使饼皮又软又好吃。

assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-s21.mp3.text: Most people think that if they eat healthy food and exercise a lot they'll live forever.
assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-s21.mp3.zh: 多数人以为只要吃得健康、多运动，就能一直活下去。

assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-s21.mp3.text: These people never drink coffee or sugary drinks.
assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-s21.mp3.zh: 这些人从不喝咖啡或含糖饮料。

assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-s21.mp3.text: They spend hours working out in the gym or doing yoga and none of this matters if you have the wrong genes.
assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-s21.mp3.zh: 他们在健身房锻炼或做瑜伽好几个小时。要是基因不合适，这些都没用。

assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-s22.mp3.text: I'd much rather go out and have a pizza with friends than spend time in the gym.
assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-s22.mp3.zh: 比起泡健身房，我宁愿和朋友出去吃披萨。

assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-s22.mp3.text: I'm really happy about this new research.
assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-s22.mp3.zh: 我对这项新研究感到很高兴。

assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-s23.mp3.text: My grandfather lived until he was 95 even though he never exercised.
assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-s23.mp3.zh: 我祖父从不锻炼，却活到了九十五岁。

assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-s24.mp3.text: He ate lots of sugar and never ate vegetables.
assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-s24.mp3.zh: 他吃很多糖，从来不吃蔬菜。

assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-s24.mp3.text: He was brought up in a different world.
assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-s24.mp3.zh: 他是在另一个时代长大的。

assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-s25.mp3.text: Of course, I'm not going to give up exercising or start eating fast food every day.
assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-s25.mp3.zh: 当然，我不会不锻炼，也不会开始每天吃快餐。

assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-s25.mp3.text: The research shows I should stay in shape because it makes me feel better but I won't allow fitness to take over my whole life.
assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-s25.mp3.zh: 研究表明我应该保持健康，因为这让我感觉更好，但我不会让健身占据整个生活。

assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c26.mp3.text: And it's not just holidays which are a problem.
assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c26.mp3.zh: 而且问题不只出在节日。

assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c26.mp3.text: Personally, I think we give too many gifts for other special occasions too.
assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c26.mp3.zh: 我个人觉得，我们在其他特殊场合也送了太多礼物。

assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c26.mp3.text: Like when my sister graduated from university last year,
assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c26.mp3.zh: 比如我姐姐去年大学毕业时，

assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c26.mp3.text: she got lots of gifts and money too.
assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c26.mp3.zh: 她也收到了很多礼物和钱。

assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c26.mp3.text: The focus was all on opening gifts.
assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c26.mp3.zh: 大家的注意力都在拆礼物上。

assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c26.mp3.text: I've heard that when people receive more than a few gifts,
assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c26.mp3.zh: 我听说，人们收到好几份礼物之后，

assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c26.mp3.text: they usually can't even remember who gave them which gift.
assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c26.mp3.zh: 往往连哪份礼物是谁送的都记不住。

assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c26.mp3.text: why not write letters of advice for the future?
assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c26.mp3.zh: 为什么不写信给他们一些对未来有用的建议呢？

assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c26.mp3.text: I doubt that graduates will be happy if we change that custom.
assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c26.mp3.zh: 如果改了这个习俗，我怀疑毕业生不会高兴。

assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c26.mp3.text: I think that graduation gifts are practical. Don't young people need some gifts and money for starting their new life?
assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c26.mp3.zh: 我觉得毕业礼物很实用。年轻人开始新的生活，难道不需要一些礼物和钱吗？

assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c26.mp3.text: And they can always look at the gift and think of the person who gave it to them.
assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c26.mp3.zh: 而且他们以后看见礼物，还可以想起送礼的人。

assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c26.mp3.text: I think it's a nice custom.
assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c26.mp3.zh: 我觉得这是个不错的习俗。

assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c31.mp3.text: Our brain is the most complex part of the human body.
assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c31.mp3.zh: 大脑是人体最复杂的部分。

assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c31.mp3.text: The brain contains billions of neurons which send signals to each other.
assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c31.mp3.zh: 大脑有数十亿个神经元，它们彼此发送信号。

assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c31.mp3.text: Everything we learn,
assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c31.mp3.zh: 我们学到的一切，

assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c31.mp3.text: our memories and feelings are a result of neurons sending signals which the brain interprets.
assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c31.mp3.zh: 以及记忆和感受，都是大脑解读神经元信号的结果。

assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c31.mp3.text: It's well known that physical exercise is good for the body.
assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c31.mp3.zh: 众所周知，运动有益于身体。

assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c31.mp3.text: But scientists are learning that it is also good for the brain.
assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c31.mp3.zh: 科学家也逐渐发现，运动同样有益于大脑。

assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c31.mp3.text: Exercise releases proteins in the brain.
assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c31.mp3.zh: 运动会使大脑释放蛋白质。

assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c31.mp3.text: And neurons need these proteins to grow and stay healthy.
assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c31.mp3.zh: 神经元需要这些蛋白质来生长和保持健康。

assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c31.mp3.text: Different kinds of exercise help the brain in different ways.
assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c31.mp3.zh: 不同的运动以不同方式帮助大脑。

assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c31.mp3.text: Aerobic exercise, like running or cycling,
assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c31.mp3.zh: 跑步或骑车等有氧运动，

assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c31.mp3.text: helps the brain to learn new skills.
assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c31.mp3.zh: 能帮助大脑学习新技能。

assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c31.mp3.text: Resistance training, like lifting weights,
assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c31.mp3.zh: 举重等抗阻训练，

assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c31.mp3.text: helps the brain to stay focused.
assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c31.mp3.zh: 能帮助大脑保持专注。

assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c31.mp3.text: Exercise programs are most successful when they are personal.
assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c31.mp3.zh: 适合个人情况的运动计划效果最好。

assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c31.mp3.text: We can use fitness trackers and apps to set fitness goals,
assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c31.mp3.zh: 我们可以用健身追踪器和应用设置健身目标，

assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c31.mp3.text: track our progress,
assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c31.mp3.zh: 跟踪进度，

assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c31.mp3.text: and access personal advice.
assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c31.mp3.zh: 还能获取个性化建议。

assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c31.mp3.text: Science is also making us think about what foods are good for our brains.
assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c31.mp3.zh: 科学研究也在促使我们思考哪些食物对大脑有益。

assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c31.mp3.text: We know that foods with lots of fat and sugar are unhealthy for our bodies.
assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c31.mp3.zh: 我们知道，高脂肪、高糖的食物对身体不利。

assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c31.mp3.text: But researchers have found that they also prevent neuron growth.
assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c31.mp3.zh: 研究人员发现，这类食物也会抑制神经元生长。

assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c31.mp3.text: This can cause problems,
assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c31.mp3.zh: 这可能引发一些问题，

assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c31.mp3.text: including headaches and poor memory.
assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c31.mp3.zh: 包括头痛和记忆力下降。

assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c31.mp3.text: Nuts are good for the brain.
assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c31.mp3.zh: 坚果对大脑有益。

assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c31.mp3.text: They contain fatty acids which support the growth of neurons,
assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c31.mp3.zh: 其中的脂肪酸有助于神经元生长，

assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c31.mp3.text: especially in the brains of young people.
assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c31.mp3.zh: 尤其是年轻人大脑中的神经元。

assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c31.mp3.text: Sleep also plays an important role in brain health.
assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c31.mp3.zh: 睡眠对大脑健康也很重要。

assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c31.mp3.text: Some people think that less sleep gives us more time during the day, so we can be more productive.
assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c31.mp3.zh: 有些人觉得少睡点，白天就有更多时间，做事也会更有成效。

assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c31.mp3.text: But few of us work effectively when we're tired.
assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c31.mp3.zh: 但人一疲倦，做事还能高效的寥寥无几。

assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c31.mp3.text: Good sleep is essential for looking after our neurons.
assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c31.mp3.zh: 优质睡眠对保护神经元至关重要。

assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c31.mp3.text: Sleep research shows that people who have had the right quality and quantity of sleep experience more positive moods.
assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c31.mp3.zh: 睡眠研究发现，睡眠质量和时长合适的人情绪更积极。

assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c31.mp3.text: They are also more able to learn new skills and remember information.
assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c31.mp3.zh: 他们也更容易学会新技能并记住信息。

assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c31.mp3.text: Smart devices can measure how long we sleep and how much of this is deep sleep.
assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c31.mp3.zh: 智能设备可以测量睡了多久，以及其中深度睡眠的时长。

assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c31.mp3.text: Scientific research into brain health,
assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c31.mp3.zh: 对大脑健康的科学研究，

assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c31.mp3.text: supported by the latest developments in technology,
assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c31.mp3.zh: 有了最新科技进展的支持，

assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c31.mp3.text: is helping us take care of and make the most of our incredible brains.
assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c31.mp3.zh: 正帮助我们呵护大脑，并充分发挥它的能力。

assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c36.mp3.text: Would you like to improve your social life,
assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c36.mp3.zh: 你想改善社交生活，

assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c36.mp3.text: your intellectual performance,
assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c36.mp3.zh: 提高思考能力，

assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c36.mp3.text: your physical fitness and your team building skills?
assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c36.mp3.zh: 增强身体素质和团队协作能力吗？

assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c36.mp3.text: Scientific research has proven that team sports offer all of these benefits.
assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c36.mp3.zh: 科学研究表明，团队运动具有这些好处。

assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c36.mp3.text: Join us and take advantage of the many benefits of team sports.
assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c36.mp3.zh: 加入我们，享受团队运动的种种益处。

assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c36.mp3.text: We're a group of energetic adults of all ages who get together on Sunday afternoons to play football.
assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c36.mp3.zh: 我们是一群来自不同年龄段、精力充沛的成年人，每周日下午聚在一起踢足球。

assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c36.mp3.text: And we're always looking for new players to join in the fun.
assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c36.mp3.zh: 我们一直欢迎新球员来一起玩。

assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c36.mp3.text: Whether you've been playing football for years or want to take up a new sport,
assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c36.mp3.zh: 无论你踢了很多年，还是想尝试一项新运动，

assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c36.mp3.text: you're welcome to participate.
assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c36.mp3.zh: 都欢迎你参加。

assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c36.mp3.text: Everyone can play.
assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c36.mp3.zh: 每个人都可以来踢球。

assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c36.mp3.text: You don't even need to try out.
assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c36.mp3.zh: 甚至不用试训。

assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c36.mp3.text: If you're interested in learning more about our group,
assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c36.mp3.zh: 如果你想进一步了解我们的团体，

assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c36.mp3.text: check out our website at
assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c36.mp3.zh: 可以访问我们的网站，

assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c36.mp3.text: www.footballsundays
assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c36.mp3.zh: www.footballsundays

assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c36.mp3.text: .cup
assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c36.mp3.zh: .cup

assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c36.mp3.text: .com
assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c36.mp3.zh: .com

assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c36.mp3.text: Sign up today and you can be part of a team as early as this weekend.
assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c36.mp3.zh: 今天报名，最快这个周末就能加入球队。

assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c36.mp3.text: Hope to see you on the field soon.
assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c36.mp3.zh: 希望很快在球场上见到你。

assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c36.mp3.text: Hi,
assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c36.mp3.zh: 你好，

assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c36.mp3.text: my name's Angie Stratton and I'm the director of Culture Cycle.
assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c36.mp3.zh: 我是安吉·斯特拉顿，骑行文化游项目的负责人。

assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c36.mp3.text: Culture Cycle is a new concept in travel,
assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c36.mp3.zh: 骑行文化游是一种新的旅行方式，

assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c36.mp3.text: educational fitness touring.
assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c36.mp3.zh: 把学习和健身结合起来。

assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c36.mp3.text: We offer courses all over the world which combine learning with exercise and travel.
assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c36.mp3.zh: 我们在世界各地开设课程，把学习、运动和旅行结合在一起。

assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c36.mp3.text: Each course has an educational theme such as Brazilian cooking or the history of Turkey.
assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c36.mp3.zh: 每门课都有一个学习主题，例如巴西烹饪或土耳其历史。

assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c36.mp3.text: As a small group,
assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c36.mp3.zh: 我们组成小团体，

assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c36.mp3.text: we cycle from place to place,
assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c36.mp3.zh: 骑车从一处到另一处，

assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c36.mp3.text: stopping for several days in each location to rest,
assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c36.mp3.zh: 在每个地方停留几天，

assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c36.mp3.text: relax and do some hands-on learning.
assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c36.mp3.zh: 休息放松，也动手学习。

assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c36.mp3.text: Not only does this trip provide terrific exercise and a fascinating cultural experience,
assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c36.mp3.zh: 这趟旅程既能充分锻炼，又能体验有趣的文化，

assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c36.mp3.text: it's the best way to learn.
assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c36.mp3.zh: 还是很好的学习方式。

assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c36.mp3.text: There's
assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c36.mp3.zh: 毫无

assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c36.mp3.text: no
assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c36.mp3.zh: 疑问，

assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c36.mp3.text: question that physical activity improves our memory and thinking skills.
assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c36.mp3.zh: 身体活动能提高记忆力和思考能力。

assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c36.mp3.text: So, after a few days of cycling,
assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c36.mp3.zh: 所以骑行几天之后，

assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c36.mp3.text: your brain will be ready to learn.
assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c36.mp3.zh: 大脑就会为学习做好准备。

assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c36.mp3.text: So, be kind to your body and your mind and come with us on an amazing adventure you'll never forget.
assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c36.mp3.zh: 善待自己的身心，加入我们，开始一段难忘的旅程吧。

assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c36.mp3.text: Are you interested in alternative treatments?
assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c36.mp3.zh: 你对替代疗法感兴趣吗？

assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c36.mp3.text: Have you ever wanted to explore the secrets of traditional Chinese medicine?
assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c36.mp3.zh: 你想了解中国传统医学的奥秘吗？

assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c36.mp3.text: This spring, join our six-month course in acupuncture,
assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c36.mp3.zh: 今年春天，欢迎参加我们的六个月针灸课程。

assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c36.mp3.text: a treatment for pain or illness which involves putting needles under the skin at special points on the body.
assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c36.mp3.zh: 针灸是在身体的特定部位把针刺入皮下，用来治疗疼痛或疾病。

assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c36.mp3.text: The course covers the theory of acupuncture and practical skills in using needles.
assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c36.mp3.zh: 课程包括针灸理论和用针实操。

assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c41.mp3.text: So our assignment is to discuss customs which have been changing recently.
assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c41.mp3.zh: 我们的作业是讨论最近正在变化的习俗。

assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c41.mp3.text: You know, how modern lifestyles have changed people's behaviour.
assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c41.mp3.zh: 就是现代生活方式怎样改变了人们的行为。

assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c41.mp3.text: Any ideas?
assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c41.mp3.zh: 有什么想法吗？

assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c41.mp3.text: Hmm,
assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c41.mp3.zh: 嗯，

assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c41.mp3.text: let me think.
assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c41.mp3.zh: 我想想。

assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c41.mp3.text: holidays are one kind of custom.
assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c41.mp3.zh: 节日就是习俗的一种。

assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c41.mp3.text: Can you think of any holidays which have changed?
assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c41.mp3.zh: 你能想到哪些节日发生了变化吗？

assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c41.mp3.text: Oh, don't talk about holidays.
assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c41.mp3.zh: 唉，别提节日了。

assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c41.mp3.text: It reminds me that Mother's Day is in two days and I haven't bought a gift for my mum yet.
assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c41.mp3.zh: 这让我想起再过两天就是母亲节了，我还没给妈妈买礼物。

assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c41.mp3.text: Yeah,
assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c41.mp3.zh: 是啊，

assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c41.mp3.text: I haven't either.
assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c41.mp3.zh: 我也没买。

assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c41.mp3.text: Who has time for shopping when we have so much work to do?
assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c41.mp3.zh: 我们有这么多事要做，哪有时间买东西？

assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c41.mp3.text: I agree.
assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c41.mp3.zh: 我同意。

assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c41.mp3.text: I get tired of shopping for gifts.
assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c41.mp3.zh: 我已经厌倦买礼物了。

assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c41.mp3.text: I actually don't know why we have to get gifts for every little holiday.
assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c41.mp3.zh: 我真的不明白为什么每个小节日都要送礼物。

assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c41.mp3.text: Wouldn't our mothers be just as happy if we just spent time with them?
assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c41.mp3.zh: 只要我们陪陪妈妈，她们不也一样高兴吗？

assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c41.mp3.text: You know, made it a special event,
assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c41.mp3.zh: 比如把那天安排得特别一点，

assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c41.mp3.text: like taking them out to lunch at a nice restaurant.
assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c41.mp3.zh: 带她们去一家不错的餐厅吃午饭。

assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c41.mp3.text: How did this whole gift-giving-for-every-holiday tradition get started anyway?
assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c41.mp3.zh: 每个节日都得送礼物，这个习惯到底是怎么来的？

assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c41.mp3.text: It seems silly to me.
assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c41.mp3.zh: 我觉得很傻。

assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c46.mp3.text: Well, first of all, I prefer to exercise and eat well.
assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c46.mp3.zh: 嗯，首先，我更愿意锻炼并且吃得健康。

assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c46.mp3.text: I also think that you won't know whether or not you have the right genes until you get sick.
assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c46.mp3.zh: 而且我认为，生病之前你不会知道自己有没有合适的基因。

assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c46.mp3.text: So why take the risk and be unhealthy?
assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c46.mp3.zh: 为什么要冒险，让自己不健康呢？

assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c46.mp3.text: Also, don't forget that you might get the flu or a cold much more easily when you don't eat healthy food or exercise.
assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c46.mp3.zh: 还别忘了，饮食不健康又不锻炼的话，更容易得流感或感冒。

assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c46.mp3.text: I'd say that it's always better to have a healthy lifestyle.
assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c46.mp3.zh: 我觉得保持健康的生活方式总是更好。

assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c46.mp3.text: doubt that bad health habits increase the chances of getting a serious illness.
assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c46.mp3.zh: 疑问，坏习惯会增加得严重疾病的可能性。

assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c46.mp3.text: So now we should all eat fast food and stop exercising?
assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c46.mp3.zh: 那我们现在都该吃快餐，别锻炼了？

assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c46.mp3.text: I mean, I look around and I see overweight children everywhere.
assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c46.mp3.zh: 我是说，我看到到处都有体重超标的孩子。

assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c46.mp3.text: matter how good their genes are, I'm sure that these children won't be able to enjoy a long and healthy life unless they give up crisps,
assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c46.mp3.zh: 论基因有多好，我相信这些孩子如果不戒掉薯片，
还有含糖饮料，就无法拥有长寿又健康的生活。

assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c46.mp3.text: Well it's great that some people can live to be a hundred and do whatever they want in their lives but I prefer to be careful and take care of myself because I don't know if I have good genes.
assets/stp1116/audio/b3l-c46.mp3.zh: 有些人想做什么就做什么还能活到一百岁，这当然很好。但我宁愿谨慎一些，照顾好自己，因为我不知道自己有没有好基因。
